decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's core thermoforming material range and had a dedicated page through 2019, so with slack in a large firm and no evident shortfall there is little trigger for problemistic search.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a staple material for dental labs that sustains repeat sales and was presented prominently, so it likely meets the aspiration level and will be kept.

The UV-curing lacquer was only mentioned and not featured, but it is a cheap complementary consumable that supports the firm's digital and custom-device workflows, so dropping it would release few resources.

Custom hearing protection earmolds draw on the firm's core earmold manufacturing skills and serve the hearing-care channel, but the removal of the related earmold line suggests some underperformance in this segment, which raises the risk of a drop without making it the likely outcome.
